summary: Round 8 PASS, with no new findings. F-DG0-132 (High), F-DG0-102 (High) and F-DG0-133 (Low) are verified fixed and CLOSED_VERIFIED. The transcript checks and the D-021 replay are now unconditional, and the CLI-replayed prompt's assignment is bound to meta. A differential reproduction shows each bypass is accepted on e11b5f08 and rejected on d6626258. The existing tests pass 52/52, prefreeze.sh passes in a fresh clone, the real round-7 runs still validate, and nothing else in tools/, .github/ or the agent frontmatter changed since the round-7 closures. Residual (disclosed in D-021, not a defect): someone with repository write access can still forge a complete, internally consistent run directory.
